verdict.rationale: Teller has no llms.txt: the probes returned 404 for /llms.txt, /docs.md and every OpenAPI path. However, its first-party doc pages are served at Markdown (.md) URLs such as /docs/api/account/balances.md and /docs/api/webhooks.md, which an agent can read directly. That counts only as thin, inferred agent-friendly documentation. Missing for 10: an llms.txt index, a root docs.md, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, any explicit agent-oriented documentation statement, and independent corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: The account balances API provides your application with live, real-time account balances.
Teller sends webhook events when specific conditions or changes are detected in user enrollments or their financial data.
